verdictEs: WuWaBuilds si quieres el workbench completo de Echoes: escaneo OCR, builds editables, showcase y leaderboards. WaveMate si solo quieres puntuar un Echo rápido y saber al instante si vale la pena guardarlo.
verdictEn: WuWaBuilds if you want the full Echo workbench: OCR scanning, editable builds, showcase, and leaderboards. WaveMate if you just want to score an Echo fast and instantly know whether it's worth keeping.
